answer: Anyone as a result has to keep each alias continuously active for 37 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The raven counter is kept in opal and river makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 37 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4712 identities would post 2522 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
